note: Standard continuation: 20 updates; forks: 8 updates from the same midpoint. The eps=0.2/kl_beta=0.1 fork is shared by the clipping and KL studies.

clipping_cached_batch.protocol:
Immediate geometric effect of eps on the supplied cached rollout batch.

    Protocol (ppo_epochs = 2, the release setting):
      * pi_old / pi_ref are recomputed with this pipeline from the midpoint, so the epoch-1 ratio is exactly 1.
        (The cached log-probs cannot be reproduced exactly: ~0.015 nats/token numerical gap; reported below.)
      * Advantages: cached effective terminal reward + KL shaping (kl_beta) + cached critic values -> GAE.
      * Epoch 1: one AdamW step on the clipped loss over the whole batch. Because the ratio is 1 everywhere,
        clipping cannot bind, so this step is identical for every eps.
      * Epoch 2: the ratios after that step are measured once; each eps is applied to the same ratios.

epoch1.note: ratio == 1 on every token in epoch 1, so the step is the same for every eps

diagnostic_cached_vs_recomputed_old.note: ratio exp(recomputed old - cached old) at the unchanged midpoint (rows with prompts <= max_prompt_length). Pure numerical/precision mismatch; shown to justify recomputing pi_old.

reference_control.note: same comparison for the frozen reference model, which never changes between the staff run and ours: any gap here is numerical by construction

supplementary_multi_epoch_sweep.note: NOT part of the required protocol (release ppo_epochs=2). Per eps, restart from the midpoint and take repeated PPO epochs on the same cached batch; stats are measured before each epoch's step.
